item.title: DataFrames.jl vs TidierData.jl vs DataFramesMeta.jl in 2026: Which Julia Data Stack Should You Actually Use?
item.description: Julia’s pitch is that you never rewrite your prototype for production. That promise breaks the moment you pick a data manipulation layer, because the three serious options sit at completely different points between “R user comfort” and “compiler-friendly zero allocation” — and migrating between them rewrites 80% of your analysis code.
